references.text: Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Simeon in the census.
Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Simeon at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Shelumiel led the army of the tribe of Simeon when they broke camp from Sinai.
Simeon was Jacob's second son with Leah, and his descendants make up the tribe of Simeon.
List of the sons of Simeon who went to Egypt, who are the ancestors of the tribe of Simeon.
